sample_unit: AI-positive head CT cases (of 2,306 patients evaluated)

links.outcome: Whether AI worklist prioritization led to faster escalation of care or surgery within 24 hours
links.effect: PPV 0.823; no significant time reduction for patients needing escalation of care or acute surgery; no cases with evident clinical benefit identified.
links.quote: Although the clinically implemented AI-based decision support system showed adequate predictive value in identifying ICH, there was no significant clinical benefit for the patients in our setting.

links.outcome: Local predictive value of the implemented ICH AI tool against radiologist-confirmed reference standard
links.effect: AI tool had a positive predictive value of 0.823 in local clinical implementation.
links.quote: The AI tool had a positive predictive value of 0.823.

screen.reason: The study evaluates a clinically implemented AI triage/worklist reprioritization tool for intracranial hemorrhage detection on CT scans to see if early evaluation translates to clinical impact (time to surgery or care escalation).

primary.practice: worklist prioritization / alert triage for early radiologist evaluation
